title: Ropelength-Filtered Knot Spaces
summary: Ropelength is usually studied as a minimisation problem for one knot at a time. Here we instead use ropelength to filter the space of all realisations of a knot type. For a knot type $K$ and budget $Λ$, let $Y_Λ(K)$ be the space of unit-thickness $C^{1,1}$ configurations of length at most $Λ$, modulo rigid motions and constant-speed reparametrisation. We prove compact capture for smooth knot families, yielding homotopical and homological exhaustion of the ordinary knot space by finite ropelength levels.
